explanations.content: The main idea is what the whole passage is mostly about. A detail supports the main idea, but it is not the main idea by itself.
explanations.story: A movie title tells the main story, while one scene is just a detail. Do not confuse one scene with the whole movie.

explanations.content: Grammar rules depend on context. A rule like adding -ed or changing tense cannot be applied blindly to every sentence.
explanations.story: Grammar is like choosing clothes for weather. A raincoat is useful in rain, but not for every day. A grammar rule works only in the right sentence context.
